comments.comment: Please pay attention that if you declare losses on your real estate due to depreciation ( as explained at 20:10 ) and you later decide to sell that same property, you will be required to pay capital gains tax on the amount you deducted. Also, there are strict requirements to qualify for a 1031 exchange, you cannot simply pick the property you want. It has to have a determined number of units, size, price and more. But it is possible
